adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built from `EmbeddableHost.all`) and does not persist anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:12-14, 18-21). The client controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});` (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7), which would hit `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` (routes + adapter) and get a 200 without any server-side changes. However, in the added `embedding.hbs` template there is no button or action wired to `saveChanges`, and actual persistence for hosts happens via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, so this is more of a misleading/unused endpoint + action than a currently user-visible broken behavior.
